claim_scope.covered_scope: One reference-anchored, event-conditioned Qwen GRPO state selected by the frozen earliest-event rule; branch-functional repair impact on one controlled SGD probe
explicit_non_claims: long-run convergence, reward or quality impact

implementation_contract.candidate: tracked Inductor Trainer-equivalent scorer plus ordinary compiled GRPO objective branch
implementation_contract.reference: eager Trainer-equivalent scorer plus ordinary reference GRPO objective branch

attribution.intervention: under identical compiled scores, replace only the selected-token ordinary compiled objective branch by the frozen reference clipped branch functional form

selected_clipping_decision.acceptance_rule: ACCEPT iff reconstructed A and B make the same selected-token clipping decision after exact parent-anchor reproduction; otherwise REJECT

selected_branch_update_effect.acceptance_rule: ACCEPT iff independently recomputed d(B,C) is exactly zero after all branch-treatment integrity gates; REJECT iff it is finite and strictly positive

selected clipping decision and boundary distance
loss and full-gradient norm per arm
next-parameter vectors T_A, T_B and T_C

population_contract.aggregation_rule: single selected-event witness only; no averaging, frequency or prevalence claim
population_contract.selection_design: earliest mechanically valid clipping disagreement under the parent v0.2 predeclared event-ordering rule, independent of repair outcome magnitude

strata.provenance: eager-anchored GRPO trajectory A2 from the valid Qwen GRPO v0.2 confirmation
